newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixes at lowest in three years.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixes at lowest in three years.

text.p: Gold was fixed at $369.00 an ounce on Tuesday morning, the lowest fixing since November 3, 1993.
It had fixed at $370.75 on Monday afternoon before tumbling still lower in New York and Asia overnight.
Gold has been moving sharply lower in recent weeks amid overwhelmingly bearish market sentiment, and analysts said the price could decline still further.
Dealers said speculators had lost interest and mining companies had been selling bullion. Fear that central banks were selling as well further undermined sentiment.
Weakness in gold spread to the other precious metals. Silver was at the lowest in over a year and platinum and palladium were trading at three-year lows.
